approach: Document-first manual authoring; existing RAG architecture was not modified. Extract reasoning in the original English, then compose learner prose independently in English and Arabic.

primary_book.catalog_title: Islam and Atheism face to face
primary_book.author_verified_from_pdf: Scholarly Committee at the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages

card_purposes.c1: Orient the learner to two arguments and free inquiry.
card_purposes.c2: Explain the causal premise and the self-creation objection.
card_purposes.c3: Examine one short canonical source instead of generating scripture.
card_purposes.c4: Explain order/function as a distinct argument.
card_purposes.c5: Clarify the scope of the premise and the beginningless-Creator reply.
card_purposes.c6: Invite optional examination without judging faith.

translation_policy.lesson_prose: Independently composed bilingual explanations; no source-first automatic translation before reasoning.
translation_policy.book_evidence: Original published English is authoritative and retained unchanged. Arabic excerpt text is a secondary AI-assisted translation, explicitly labelled in ref_ar and translation metadata, pending scholarly review. It is not claimed to be a published Arabic edition.
translation_policy.scripture: Existing acquired KFGQPC Arabic and Sahih International English records, with only the Arabic terminal verse-number marker omitted to match the source gateway convention.

omitted: Scientific assertions about cosmology, entropy, genetics and evolution were not imported.
Polemic and generalized claims about atheists were not imported.
Fitrah, suffering, religious truth claims and full cosmological/design debates are beyond this short course.
limits: The course presents two arguments and their premises; it does not establish that these arguments alone prove every Islamic belief.
The beginningless-Creator card explains the response and its scope; it is not an exhaustive defence against objections to causality or regress.
All new excerpts and secondary translations remain pending review.
The current player hides source buttons on concept cards. Source references remain in the course and quiz; quote and quiz-source views can display records.

self_review.bilingual_meaning: Checked for equivalent claims, scope and qualifications; phrasing adapted to each language.
self_review.quiz: Three questions, parallel options, correct positions 1/0/2; tests understanding of presented arguments, not personal belief.
self_review.schema: Current CourseDraft only; no unsupported intro/actions/tags/needs_review fields.
self_review.source_support: All doctrinal and argument claims mapped above; pedagogical invitations are editorial.
